description: vcruz305's one-Spark Ripple-65B-Preview lane on SGLang v0.5.19 (Ripple-65B-Preview-EXL3-SGLang-recipe at f4de1bdd): his EXL3 SAGE-REXL3 pack at 5.41 bits per weight (45.2 GB, 10 shards) with his 4.55bpw EXL3 DFlash2 draft (16 draft tokens, 16384-token draft window), served through his sglang-exl3 plugin at the pinned 5d1c9efd and his vendored serve_ripple.py, which registers the RicursiveForCausalLM class and the ripple tool-call and reasoning parsers. Launch exactly as his serve_ripple.py defaults: triton attention with page size 64, bfloat16 KV cache, prefill CUDA graphs disabled, mem-fraction-static 0.82, 8 running requests and a 131,072-token context (both settings), the chat template his serve_ripple.py defaults to (byte-identical to the pack's own copy), text only. Reasoning text is split out when the output opens with <think> (the template has no thinking switch, so the model decides) and tool calls use the ripple parser. This is a port as an estimate: the creator measured it only on one x86 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB (sm_120) and claims no Spark run, although his scripts select the GB10 arch (12.1a) themselves; the hardware try decides. Inferred pin: his setup.sh leaves the exllamav3 ref empty (default-branch head at clone time), so the image builds turboderp-org/exllamav3 at 27dbad01, the last master commit before his first commit. Open questions for the hardware try: flashinfer kernels on sm_121 in the v0.5.19-cu130 image (the build scan covers only the compiled exllamav3_ext), the plugin pin on GB10, and the inferred exllamav3 pin. Upstream claims, not measured here: on 96 GB at 0.82, weights 42.46 GB, draft 2.19 GB, KV pool 30.11 GB (117,376 full and 93,888 SWA tokens), about 83 GB used after graph capture. The 115.6 GB peak is 0.82 of the Spark's total memory plus the 8.5 GB SGLang single-Spark margin, not measured here; on a Spark the same fraction gives a larger KV pool than the creator had. Licences are informational: the recipe repository is MIT, the packs and the base model are Apache-2.0.
title: Ripple 65B Preview SAGE-REXL3 5.41bpw + DFlash2 SGLang single Spark (vcruz305)
